fixed_bugs: Expired cached weak child tokens could compare equal and pass publication/admission; explicit liveness now rejects them
Final admission callbacks could replace a child after returning its old token; checked activation refuses that old life
Raw requests now freeze operation-entry contributor identity before callbacks instead of following a replacement
Stale activation and producer decline no longer run after-dispatch hooks as if dispatched
boundaries: Default checked method assumes observational child reads and a directly owned model. Deeper shared models must override under their real mutable owner borrow.
No host check can recover hidden model transitions or make a lying/impure contributor truthful.
ProducerActionDispatch is dispatch/refusal, not durable or asynchronous completion. Trusted current-context act remains available; host ingress uses act_checked.
Optional child None keeps the explicit never-reused-key contract. Cached expired Some is never treated as legacy None.
